reviewers.summary: The executive `/work` route redirects to `/portfolio`, contrary to the required denial state. The App tests also omit the required `/work` and role-matched decision-panel coverage.

findingList.message: Executive `/work` redirects to `/portfolio` instead of displaying the required workspace-denial message.

evidence.codePathTraced: For an executive on `/work`, `desiredRoute` becomes the role home because `/work` does not match the executive role. The effect redirects before the workspace-denial message can remain visible.
evidence.failureScenario: An executive opens `/work` and is redirected to `/portfolio` instead of seeing exactly `This page is not part of your workspace`.

findingList.message: The required executive `/work` behavior is not covered by the named `role route navigation` test.

evidence.codePathTraced: `role route navigation` checks executive navigation to `/portfolio`; it does not navigate to `/work` or assert the denial message, absence of worklist data, and absence of decision controls.
evidence.failureScenario: If executive `/work` redirects or displays worklist data, `role route navigation` still passes.

findingList.message: The required App-host test for role-matched decision panels is missing.

evidence.codePathTraced: The changed App tests cover executive portfolio navigation and row selection, but no App-host test named `executive_case_read_only_and_role_matched_decision_panels` checks role-matched decision panels.
evidence.failureScenario: If App displays a technical or finance decision panel for the wrong role, the standalone summary test still passes.

reviewers.summary: The executive `/work` route does not meet the specified denial behavior. The endpoint-loading and App-level role-matched panel criteria also lack the required tests.

findingList.message: Executive `/work` redirects to `/portfolio` instead of showing the required workspace denial state.

evidence.codePathTraced: The route effect sends any executive route other than `/portfolio` or a case route to the executive role home, `/portfolio`. Therefore `/work` does not remain active to show the workspace denial message.
evidence.failureScenario: An executive opens `/work`; the app redirects to `/portfolio` instead of showing exactly `This page is not part of your workspace`, contrary to the acceptance criterion. OWASP A01:2025 Broken Access Control.

findingList.message: The named AC_016 test does not verify that `/portfolio` loads `GET /api/v1/workspace/portfolio` through App.

evidence.codePathTraced: `AC_016_portfolio_kpis_contract` renders `ExecutivePortfolio` directly with supplied rows; it does not exercise `/portfolio` through App or assert a request to `GET /api/v1/workspace/portfolio`.
evidence.failureScenario: If App stops requesting the portfolio endpoint, the component test still passes, so the endpoint-loading behavior in the criterion is untested.

findingList.message: The required App-host test for role-matched decision panels and read-only behavior is missing.

evidence.codePathTraced: The changed App tests cover portfolio navigation and row selection, but the required `executive_case_read_only_and_role_matched_decision_panels` test is absent. The standalone summary test does not exercise App's role-specific panel rendering.
evidence.failureScenario: If App renders a technical or finance decision panel for the wrong role, the changed tests still pass.

reviewers.summary: The executive route guard redirects `/work` to `/portfolio`, so the required denial state is unreachable. The named route test does not exercise `/work` to catch this behavior.

findingList.message: Executive `/work` is redirected to `/portfolio` instead of showing the required workspace denial message.

evidence.codePathTraced: When an executive visits `/work`, the role-route check replaces a route outside the executive workspace with the role home, `/portfolio`, before the denial message can render.
evidence.failureScenario: An executive opens `/work` and is redirected to `/portfolio` instead of seeing exactly `This page is not part of your workspace`.

findingList.message: The required executive `/work` behavior is not covered by the named `role route navigation` test.

evidence.codePathTraced: The `role route navigation` test signs in as an executive and checks `/portfolio`; it does not visit `/work` or assert the denial message, absence of worklist data, and absence of decision controls required by the acceptance criterion.
evidence.failureScenario: If executive `/work` displays worklist data or omits the required denial message, this test still passes.
